purpose: Targeted verification of two known examples cited by GJ.cool; not a random audit or a corpus error-rate estimate.
method: Parse label.csv with UTF-8-SIG and csv.DictReader. Follow Link next pagination for the recursive HF tree. Compare LFS SHA256 values for duplicates. Download and visually inspect only the two cited images.

repository_comparison.limitation: Current main trees only; not historical proof of the February release.

images.limitation: The reason for the difference between the published 2973 and the main image directories 2980 was not confirmed.
